scripts.build: npm run build:tokens && npm run build --workspace @surflane/ui
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run build:llms && npm run build:fonts && vite demo --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8066
scripts.build:catalog: npm run build && npm run check:catalog && npm run build:llms && npm run build:fonts && vite build demo --manifest && node scripts/prerender.mjs && npm run check:catalog-build
scripts.format: node scripts/format-snippets.mjs && prettier --write packages scripts demo tests examples docs *.json *.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check packages scripts demo tests examples docs *.json *.md && node scripts/format-snippets.mjs --check
scripts.build:pages: npm run build && npm run check:catalog && npm run build:llms && npm run build:fonts && node scripts/build-pages.mjs
scripts.test:catalog-loading:prod: npm run build:catalog && playwright test --config playwright.catalog.config.ts
scripts.check:package: tsc -p tests/contracts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/package/tsconfig.json && node scripts/check-package.mjs
